user.title: Set up HA Health Monitor
user.description: Add the integration. Monitoring starts with safe default settings.

abort.already_configured: HA Health Monitor is already configured.

init.title: Monitoring settings and conditional entities
init.description: Choose what to monitor and configure integration activity profiles. Only selected conditional entities are ignored while a reference entity is inactive.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often Home Assistant state is checked.
data_description.excluded_entities: These entities are excluded from availability and freshness checks.
data_description.monitor_freshness: Disabled by default. Only selected entities are observed. Each entity learns its own update cadence from real reports.
data_description.freshness_entities: Select sensor or binary sensor entities expected to report regularly. Each needs at least five valid intervals before stale detection starts. The learning period depends on the entity.
data_description.freshness_threshold_multiplier: Manual global tolerance applied to each entity's learned cadence. Higher values are more tolerant and delay stale warnings; default is 3.0.
data_description.activity_profile_config_entry: Choose the integration instance whose conditional entities you want to manage.
data_description.activity_profile_reference_entity: For example, the binary sensor that indicates whether the washer is running.
data_description.activity_profile_conditional_entities: Select only entities expected to be unavailable when the device is idle. All other entities remain monitored.
data_description.activity_profile_inactive_states: Exact states that mean inactive, for example off or idle.
data_description.activity_profile_remove: Remove the profile for the selected integration instance.

abort.invalid_activity_profile: The selected integration, reference entity, conditional entities or inactive states are invalid.

scan_now.name: Scan now
scan_now.description: Run an immediate HA Health Monitor scan.

reset_freshness_learning.name: Reset freshness learning
reset_freshness_learning.description: Reset the learned update cadence for one selected entity or all selected entities.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Leave empty to reset all selected freshness profiles.

set_entity_excluded.name: Set entity monitoring exclusion
set_entity_excluded.description: Include or exclude one entity from HA Health Monitor.

excluded.name: Excluded
excluded.description: Whether to omit the entity from monitoring.

set_integration_availability_profile.name: Configure integration activity profile
set_integration_availability_profile.description: Pause entity monitoring for one integration while its reference entity reports an explicit inactive state.

set_availability_profile.name: Configure device availability profile
set_availability_profile.description: Configure conditional availability for a device.
